title: The Code That Saved the Moon Landing 🌕✨

segments.text: Minutes from the Moon. Abort, or land?
segments.say: Minutes from the Moon. Abort, or land?

segments.text: The software was built for this: drop the small jobs, *keep what matters.*
segments.say: The software was built for exactly this. Drop the less important jobs, and keep only what matters.

segments.text: The team behind it was led by *Margaret Hamilton.* She was 32.
segments.say: The team behind it was led by Margaret Hamilton. She was thirty-two.

segments.text: *They landed.* She died this September, at 90.
segments.say: They landed. Hamilton died this September, at ninety.

segments.text: *Why it matters:* software that expects failure is now basic engineering. She helped make it a discipline.
